method: Bounded public search and page-text retrieval. No site visit, outreach, private leases, resident census, MC accounts, paid data or transaction authentication.

entries.observation: Lists Taman Equine station at Jalan Putra Permai, Bandar Putra Permai.
entries.supports: A rail-context lead for the Zeva investigation.
entries.limits: Does not establish Zeva's route, travel time, walkability, tenant use or price effect.

entries.observation: Lists both Taman Equine and Cyberjaya Utara / Cyberjaya City Centre.
entries.supports: Rail presence is not an exclusive Equine-versus-Cyberjaya distinction.
entries.limits: Does not show either project's functional access or tenant capture.

entries.observation: Identifies the international school at 22 Jalan Kiara, Mont'Kiara.
entries.supports: International-school ecosystem context for the family hypothesis.
entries.limits: No evidence of Pines household share, school enrolment by building, management quality, buyer budget or willingness to pay.

entries.access: Search extract obtained; initial open returned document metadata; subsequent targeted open timed out
entries.observation: Describes Cyberview's role in developing Cyberjaya's technology ecosystem.
entries.supports: A non-student demand-source hypothesis worth testing.
entries.limits: Neither employment forecasts nor this institutional role prove current numbers or Solstice worker occupancy. No job counts adopted.

entries.observation: A master-room offering question and a furnished-room seeking question appear in Eve's project Q&A.
entries.supports: A counterexample lead to an absolute whole-unit-only narrative.
entries.limits: No executed tenancy, current availability, representative sample, household identity or relative room/whole-unit share. Does not refute a relative privacy preference.

entries.access: Search extract only; direct opening returned 410 Gone
entries.observation: Indexed title describes an East Lake master-room offer.
entries.limits: Not current availability, an independently titled small dwelling, legal partition proof, executed rent or student/room dominance.

entries.access: Search extract only; direct opening returned 410 Gone
entries.observation: Indexed advertisement describes a Subang Avenue room with shared facilities.
entries.limits: Old offer; not current price, availability, partition legality, tenant identity, representative occupancy or confirmed travel time. Metadata has inconsistent property classification.

entries.access: Search extract obtained; direct opening timed out
entries.observation: Advertises Maxim 825 sf, two bedrooms/two bathrooms, furnished, one bay, RM2,500 per month.
entries.supports: Whole-unit marketed product exists as a counterexample lead to a room-only Cheras narrative.
entries.limits: Not an achieved rent, current availability or tenant-mode share. Older offer is not substituted for the unchanged RM2,000 scenario.
